description: Publishes privacy-minimized, source-defined current active City of Chicago business-license sites while preserving every license row and avoiding one-license-equals-one-business overcounting.
redirect_policy: Reject redirects and accept only HTTPS requests to the exact data.cityofchicago.org metadata and uupf-x98q JSON resource paths.
retry: Retry HTTP 429, 5xx, and transient transport failures with bounded exponential backoff. Do not retry redirects, other 4xx responses, source-filter drift, schema drift, refresh drift, duplicate Socrata row identity, or quality-gate failures.
checkpoint: Acquire the official filtered view in deterministic account-number, site-number, license-id, and Socrata-row order. Hash the complete selected-field source snapshot before grouped normalization. Recheck metadata and count before publication; publish manifest and current pointer last and atomically.
idempotency: The catalog rowsUpdatedAt timestamp plus SHA-256 of the ordered selected-field source artifact identify a source release. Account number identifies a provisional organization; account-number/site-number identifies one source-defined licensed site regardless of license count.
cancellation: Abort network and local grouping cooperatively, close partition streams, retain unpublished run-scoped staging for diagnosis, and do not change current.json.
retention_profile: Retain immutable internal selected-field source snapshots and local-review-only normalized releases until an approved retention operation removes them.
